items.title: Personal data may be stored on an unmanaged personal device
items.default_action: Identify whether the device is organisation-managed and apply appropriate access, encryption, backup and remote-wipe controls where applicable.

items.title: Encryption control reported absent
items.default_action: Review the storage/transport architecture and implement appropriate security safeguards based on the nature and risk of the personal data.

items.title: Retention period is unknown
items.default_action: Define the purpose-driven retention period and the deletion/archive process, taking applicable legal and operational requirements into account.

items.title: Child-data processing requires review
items.default_action: Verify whether the individual is a child, identify the applicable legal basis/consent mechanism and review the specific child-data requirements and exemptions that apply.

items.title: Third-party sharing is not fully understood
items.default_action: Identify every external recipient, purpose, role, contractual arrangement and relevant security/privacy controls.

items.title: Privacy notice may be missing
items.default_action: Review whether an appropriate notice is provided at or before collection as applicable, including the relevant personal-data and purpose information.

items.title: Government identification information requires necessity review
items.default_action: Document the specific purpose and legal/business necessity for collecting the identifier and review whether a less intrusive alternative is appropriate.

items.title: Health-related information requires enhanced review
items.default_action: Review purpose, access restrictions, retention, security safeguards and applicable legal requirements for the health information.

items.title: Biometric processing identified
items.default_action: Document the purpose, necessity, security safeguards, retention and applicable legal requirements before relying on biometric collection.
